name: AWS CloudTrail - Default Policy Version Set

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail (SetDefaultPolicyVersion)
| parse "\"eventSource\":\"*\"" as eventSource | where eventSource="iam.amazonaws.com"
| parse "\"eventName\":\"*\"" as eventName | where eventName="SetDefaultPolicyVersion"
// EoQ

description: This search looks for CloudTrail events where a user has set a default policy versions. Attackers have been know to use this technique for Privilege Escalation in case the previous versions of the policy had permissions to access more resources than.
